one_line_description: Corporate card, spend management, and corporate banking platform for growing businesses.

authentication.other: User API Token or Team API Token (Bearer)

credential_access.notes: Requires an active, approved Brex corporate cash/card customer account; API tokens must be created by account administrators.

mcp.notes: Composio provides Brex toolkit; community MCP implementations exist.

buildability.blocker: Workspace administrator approval or enterprise tenant permission required
buildability.rationale: End-users cannot provision integrations directly; tenant admin consent or security review is mandatory.

evidence.title: Brex API Authentication Overview
evidence.excerpt: Brex APIs use Bearer token authentication. Account administrators can generate user and team API tokens from the Brex dashboard integrations page.
